'''Gillehspy''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He commanded the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Hound (Star Destroyer)|''Hound'']]

After [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gregg]] informed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] of [[Dass Jennir]]'s location on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kestavel]], Vader told Gregg to inform Gillehspy to prepare the ''Hound'' to leave within the hour.

During their mission at Kestavel, after they were getting reports that Vader's soldiers were caught in an engine fuel-laced trap, Gillehspy, observing the battle from the hull of the ship, attempted to get more information from the bridge, although he was forced to drop the subject at blasterpoint by Lieutenant Gregg, who had earlier been ordered by Vader to prevent any of the Imperial forces from interfering with Vader's mission, not even to aid Vader.
